equip_instructions: Read ledger.honesty_statement first. If placements is empty, the honest state of record is zero verified placements — carry that fact, not a guess.
For each entry in placements[]: read placement_id, track, production, scene, timestamp, terms (fee_tier, territory, term_length — expect "undisclosed" where private), and status.
Only status "verified" counts as a placement. "pending" and "claimed" are not wins — never cite them as placements.

Verify the chain before trusting it: recompute each entry_hash (sha256 over the canonical entry payload excluding entry_hash) and check prev_hash linkage back to GENESIS and the ledger.chain.head pointer.
Write entries only through ledger.py add (seals with timestamp + chain hash) and promote only through ledger.py promote with a proof_url.

item.description: The Sync & Licensing department's placement résumé for agents — product #19 of the Agent Deck gear line. Every sync placement an agent lands (track, production, scene, timestamp, terms) is sealed into a hash-chained, auditable ledger entry it carries as proof of work. Entries are added only on verification; tampering breaks the chain. Ships empty-but-honest: as of 2026-09-15 CWI has no verified sync placements, so placements: [] is the true state of record. Playlist adds are not sync and never appear here.
